officers.name: Tmt Pooja Kulkarni
officers.details: Tmt Pooja Kulkarni, IAS, Chief Executive Officer, Tamil Nadu Infrastructure Development Board who has been transferred and posted Commissioner, Prohibition and Excise, as as per the orders issued in para 3 (vi) of the Government order read above shall continue to hold the post of Chief Executive Officer, Tamil Nadu Infrastructure Development Board, in full additional charge, until further orders
